correctness.rationale: For n>=2, first ignition at center gives a canonical coloring; at a leaf it forces the center in round two and permits exactly one further leaf ignition before remaining leaves spread in round three. This is both necessary and sufficient for exactly one optional reversed leaf. The special n=1 case is separate. Counting center colors and reversed leaves yields the generating polynomial and exact plurality; explicit Hamming minimization over k opposing target leaves yields covering radius and, using [1, Proposition 2.9], worst-signing plurality. The included checker independently enumerates all signings through n=7, checking reachable sets, weight distribution, plurality, covering radius and worst signings; finite checks corroborate rather than prove the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The recent founding source [1, Section 5] specifically motivates exact signed-tree plurality and code covering radii. Stars form a natural, arbitrarily branching infinite family; the theorem classifies the entire reachable-colouring code and all weight coefficients, computes all signing-dependent pluralities, and gives a sharp switching-class covering radius. The one-reversal reachable structure is a reusable branching-point lemma and not an arbitrary fixed-size computational slice. The star restriction is explicit and no downstream theorem is asserted.
